author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be a serious breach of privacy yet again committed by private companies getting in the same bed with mercenary cyber companies. Tim Hortons has been accused of working with an analytics company that appears to be taking far more data then they should. What happens with that data? Let's try and find out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: This Country Keeps Tracking My Location...
